BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL  ON THE 19 th OF JUNE, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 18016 of 2023 BETWEEN:-
AJAY JATAV S/O MANGLIYA SINGH JATAV, AGED 18 YEARS, R/O PREMNAGAR JOURA KHURD CIVIL LINE,
DISTRICT- MORENA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....APPLICANT (BY SHRI MUKESH CHANDRA PATHAK- ADVOCATE)
AND STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE STATION- CIVIL LINE, DISTRICT- DATIA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....RESPONDENT (BY SHRI P.S. RAGHUVANSHI- PUBLIC PROSECUTOR)

This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER
This is the Second application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

The first application was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to revive the prayer after recording the statements of the prosecutrix by this Court vide order dated 03/02/2023 passed in MCRC No.5555/2023.

Applicant has been arrested on 16/12/2022 by Police Station- Civil Line, District- Morena (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.1282/2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 376 and 511 of IPC and Sections 7/8 of POCSO Act and further added Sections 3/4 and 18 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Police Station- Civil Line, District- Morena
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Allegations against the applicant, in short, are that on 12/12/2022, the complainant had gone to market to purchase the wheat and granddaughters of the complainant were playing outside the house, then the applicant came there and took them to his house and put off their clothes.
Thereafter, he also put off his clothes.
When the prosecutrix tried to scream, applicant shut her mouth.
Thereafter, on screaming by the prosecutrix, applicant ran away from the spot.

On the basis Ajay Jatav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5998642/
1 of aforesaid, crime has been registered against the applicant.

sentences.text: Thereafter, applicant was arrested on 16/12/2022 and after investigation, charge- sheet has been submitted.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is aged 18 years and he has falsely been implicated in the offence.
After investigation, charge- sheet has been filed, therefore, further custodial interrogation is not required in the matter.
It is further submitted that complainant and prosecutrix have been examined who have not supported the prosecution case and turned hostile.
Applicant is in custody since 20/02/2023 and he is the permanent resident of District- Datia (M.P.).
Conclusion of trial will take time.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the case diary.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if applicant furnishes a cash security of Rs.25,000/- alongwith a personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of any default, cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall be forfeited without giving any notice.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE rahul SINGH RAHUL
